title: Two border encounters
hook: A display can be compared with a physical contest.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: In a toy record, one border encounter ends after a call; another continues to physical contact. Which encounter has no contact in the stated record?

misconception: The stated evidence implies a different interpretation or a universal conclusion.
objective: In a toy record, one border encounter ends after a call; another continues to physical contact. Which encounter has no contact in the stated record?

claims.text: In a toy record, one border encounter ends after a call; another continues to physical contact. Which encounter has no contact in the stated record? The call panel ends with the two animals apart. The other panel shows contact. This is a stipulated comparison of two possible outcomes, not proof that territorial calls always prevent fights.

claims.text: The panels show a stipulated illustrative model and do not depict observed data.
Two toy animals call and then remain apart. What is observed? The record states a call and separation, not physical contact.
